The '''Purge of 1865''' was a Saochian political and intellectual crackdown against alternative philosophies, including [[Kaonism]].

== Course ==

Old source material says Kaonist texts were banned after reformist literati and provincial cooperatives circulated [[Liao Zhengyuan]]'s writings. Liao was arrested and disappeared soon after, presumed to have died in exile.

== Consequences ==

The purge prevented Kaonism from becoming a mass movement in its birthplace. It also helped push surviving Kaonist adherents and related reform circles eastward, where Kaonist concepts later entered the ideological background of political [[Taoism]].
